header.title: APR blind spot calculator
header.intro: An APR tells you the yearly rate, not what a new purchase really costs. Add planned spending to a card balance and see how much longer payoff could take, and how much more interest you could pay, at the same monthly payment.

demoBanner.strong: Illustrative only — not advice or an offer.
demoBanner.body: Uses the balance, APR, and payment you enter. Fees, rate changes, minimum-payment rules, and other new charges are not modeled.
